 affliction of vain breath] ‘Their tortured breathing as they run’ (GM).
 Chasing or running away from shadows that have been thrown by clouds or birds, the figures in

 more,] more Box 1. crossed,] crossed Box 1.
 shunned] spurned 1824.
 grew,] grew; Box 1.
 dew] Used figuratively to mean the water produced by the fountain. Cp. the opening line of To
Constantia (‘The red Rose that drinks the fountain dew’) (Longman ii 328–9, no. 147).
 cells] Natural caverns or wells. burst,] burst Box 1.
 And grassy paths and wood, lawn-interspersed 1824. wood lawns] Grass clearings within a wood.
 elms,] elms Box 1. cold,] cold Box 1.
 the South wind] Preceded by the [?East] canc. in Box 1 (the second word is read as heat in TL
(Reiman) and blast in BSM). Reiman (2002) glosses this wind as the libeccio, the Southwest wind, but S.
